remarks: Coastal Living, Beautifully Reimagined! Welcome to Mira Costa Villas, where an incredible top-to-bottom refresh meets the laid-back charm of San Clemente! Ideally located across from Mira Costa Park, this 3-bedroom, 2.25-bath townhome is filled with fresh finishes, thoughtful improvements and an inviting coastal vibe. Step inside and feel the difference! Soaring vaulted ceilings create an airy, open atmosphere, while brand-new blonde luxury vinyl flooring, fresh paint, recessed lighting in every room and new family room windows bring warmth and light throughout. The beautifully refreshed kitchen shines with new quartz countertops featuring elegant warm marbling, complemented by updated cabi
